# Campus Climate Network

> Campus Climate Network (CCN) is a US-based nonprofit coalition of 50+ student-led organizations fighting for climate justice on college campuses. CCN trains student organizers, coordinates national campaigns, and builds long-term movement infrastructure. Its flagship campaign, Fossil Free Research, works to cut fossil fuel industry money out of university research. Formerly known as Fossil Free Research (renamed Campus Climate Network in October 2023).

Contact: info@campusclimatenetwork.org

## Key pages

- [About / Our approach](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/our-approach): How CCN trains organizers, coordinates campaigns, and builds infrastructure
- [Our story](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/our-story): Timeline from the Fossil Free Research open letter (2022) to today
- [Our network](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/our-network): Member organizations and membership criteria
- [Campaigns](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/campaigns): Winning campaigns run by CCN member groups
- [Impact](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/impact): Leadership development stats, campaign wins, and testimonials
- [Programs](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/programs): Student Power Gatherings, Organizing Fellowship, campus trainings, coaching, and research programs
- [2025 Impact Report](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/impact-reports/2025): Annual report with key numbers and highlights
- [Open letter](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/open-letter): Open letter signed by 1,000+ academics calling for fossil-free research
- [Blog](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/blog): Dispatches from student organizers and campaign wins

## Get involved

- [Take action / join](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/take-action): Intake form for students and groups joining the network
- [Donate](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/donate): Support student climate organizing
- [Careers](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/hiring): Open positions
- [Contact](https://www.campusclimatenetwork.org/contact-us): Collaborations, media requests, partnerships
